title: This Fish Shoots Insects Out of the Air With a Jet of Water
subject: archerfish

scenes.text: This fish shoots insects out of the air with water, and the water should make it miss.
It spits a jet from its mouth at bugs perched above the surface and knocks them into the water.
Here's the problem. Light bends where air meets water, so the insect isn't where it looks.
Yet in lab tests, archerfish told targets apart that differed by just one to three millimeters.
Scientists think they learn to correct for the bend, and they have to master it young to survive.
A fish that fixes bent light, one meal at a time.
